title: Cursor
description: A position in an ordered log (contract 07). type hub: a reader's place in a hub stream (C-07.18 to C-07.21). type source: the hub's durable place in one chat's daemon ring, sent to the connector at attach (C-07.10) and returned in events.ack (C-07.11).

hub.description: A hub stream cursor. seq 0 means before the first event.

stream.description: The hub stream: chat:<chat_id>, machine:<machine_id>, or hub (C-07.1, section 2).

epoch.description: The stream's epoch: ep_ and a ULID, re-minted only when the stream's numbering is rewritten (C-07.4).

seq.description: The last hub seq the reader holds.

source.description: The hub's source cursor for one chat's daemon. boot null means none held yet (first attach: read from since 0).

type.description: Discriminator: a daemon ring cursor held by the hub.

chat_id.description: The chat label (contract 03 section 2): the chat id without its `cht_` prefix, as every 05 frame names a chat on the link. The hub maps it to the chat id it records.

ring.description: The ring the cursor is in.

oneOf.description: A daemon's per-boot token, read from the X-WC-Boot response header where the daemon sends it (C-07.9, Q-07.1), else from GET /api/health (web-chat-dev.worktrees/ae-int/lib/server/routes/health.js:131). Today `${pid}:${Date.now()}` from lib/server/index.js:156; from alpha.4 random per createServer and without the pid (C-07.15, Q-07.8). Opaque to the hub: compared for equality only, never parsed (C-07.36).

boot.description: The boot the seq belongs to, or null when nothing has been ingested.

seq.description: The highest ring position known for that boot (C-07.11, C-07.12): in a live stream every entry counts one position, captures included; in a catch-up replay a capture's position is unknown, so only non-capture entries move it, and a counted position is a lower bound. A poll's latest (lib/core/bus.js:213, nextSeq - 1) is exact, and the connector MAY set the cursor from it.

capture_seq.description: Highest capture counter ingested, for GET /api/captures?since (capture.js:280-289). Boot-independent: the counter is seeded past everything on disk at boot (lib/server/graph.js:432-452). A capture next_cursor or a capture entry's counter below it, read at a boot change, is a re-initialised surface. Set to 0 when surface_gen is raised (C-07.12a).

element_seq.description: Highest element log seq reconciled, for GET /api/elements?since (lib/server/routes/elements.js:73-74; next_cursor is elements().maxSeq(), :701). Boot-independent: the log is append-only. Set to 0 when surface_gen is raised, and alone, leaving surface_gen, when an element next_cursor read at a boot change is below it (C-07.12a).

surface_gen.description: The chat's surface generation (C-07.12a): from 1, raised by 1 when a batch reports reinit (the chat's .web-chat/ was removed and initialised again). Part of every capture key, capture/<surface_gen>/<capture_id>. Absent means 1.
